data.description:
Implement plugins/dso/scripts/commit-override.sh to make T2 tests pass.

## Implementation logic
1. Parse --reason= argument; exit 1 with usage message if absent
2. TTY check: [ -t 0 ] || [[ -n "${DSO_FORCE_INTERACTIVE:-}" ]] || { echo 'ERROR: commit-override must be invoked interactively' >&2; exit 1; }
3. Autonomous mode check: [[ -n "${DSO_FBKY_AUTONOMOUS_MODE:-}" ]] && { echo 'ERROR: commit-override unavailable in autonomous mode' >&2; exit 1; }
4. source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/deps.sh; ARTIFACTS_DIR=$(get_artifacts_dir); mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS_DIR"
5. diff_hash=$(git diff --cached | sha256sum | cut -c1-12)
6. Write $ARTIFACTS_DIR/override.token as JSON: {diff_hash, reason, timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC), attribution: {skill_name: null, agent_id: null}}
7. Append a JSON Lines entry to $ARTIFACTS_DIR/commit-overrides.log (same fields)

## Post-implementation
chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/commit-override.sh

## Classification
GREEN — implement to make T2 tests pass

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/commit-override.sh (CREATE)
